note: Document-agnostic probe set for research-PDF assistants. Retrieval metrics (Recall@K, Precision@K, MRR) are computed when expected_sources match retrieved labels/pages for an uploaded paper. Generation metrics use reference_answer for manual or LLM-as-judge scoring.
